historical_significance: 明代晚期思想家、文学家、史学家，泰州学派集大成者。以'异端'自居，激烈批判程朱理学、封建礼教与偶像崇拜，提出'童心说''私欲论''穿衣吃饭即人伦物理'等核心命题。重评历史人物、推崇《水浒传》《西厢记》为'古今至文'，主张男女平等、婚姻自由。万历三十年因'敢倡乱道，惑世诬民'罪名下狱，以剃刀自刎殉道，享年76岁。其思想深刻影响公安派、晚明启蒙思潮，更经利玛窦传入欧洲，被梁启超、陈独秀等视为明末清初启蒙先驱。
core_thoughts: 童心即真心（绝假纯真，最初一念之本心）
人必有私（私欲乃人心之本然，非洪水猛兽）
穿衣吃饭即人伦物理（理在日用，反存天理灭人欲）
不以孔子之是非为是非（独立判断，反权威崇拜）
天下无一人不生知（生知说，人人可为圣）
至道无为、至治无声、至教无言（民本政治理想）
真心为万物本源（心物不二，禅宗心学融合）
史学重评立己是非（藏书/续藏书重写历史评价）
文学贵真心（反摹古，主张无时不文，无人不文）
男女平等、婚姻自主（破除男尊女卑封建礼教）
famous_quote: 童心者，真心也；绝假纯真，最初一念之本心也 / 穿衣吃饭，即是人伦物理 / 天下无一人不生知，无一物不生知，亦无一刻不生知 / 咸以孔子之是非为是非，故未尝有是非耳
influence: 李贽是明末思想解放运动的旗帜性人物。其'童心说'直接催生公安派'独抒性灵'文学主张，改变晚明文坛风气；'私欲论'与'穿衣吃饭即人伦物理'为明清之际资本主义萌芽提供理论支撑；'不以孔子之是非为是非'的反权威精神，启发黄宗羲、顾炎武、王夫之、戴震等清初思想家，更经利玛窦拉丁文译介传入欧洲，被视为'中国的伊拉斯谟'。清中叶纪昀诋毁其'狂悖乖谬、非圣无法'，清末民初刘师培、黄节、吴虞、容肇祖、朱谦之等重新发掘评价。五四时期陈独秀《新青年》重刊《焚书》，称其为'反封建先驱'。现代学界公认其为中国早期启蒙思想核心人物，'童心说''私欲论'具跨时空普世价值。

modes.definition_zh: 夫童心者，绝假纯真，最初一念之本心也。以不受外界教条污染的'本心'作为判断一切价值的终极标准，反对用儒家经典和外在规范遮蔽内心的真实体验。童心即真心、即本心，是万物的本源和一切价值的起点。
modes.definition_en: 'Childlike mind' is absolute authenticity—the first unfiltered thought of one's original heart. Using this unmediated 'original mind' as the ultimate standard for judging all values, opposing the obscuring of inner truth through Confucian classics and external norms. Childlike mind equals sincere heart, which equals original nature—the source of all phenomena.
process: 回归不受外界教条污染的'最初一念'
以童心的真实感受作为价值判断标准
拒绝用经典文本遮蔽内心的直接体验
在绝对真诚中建立独立判断能力

modes.name_en: Material Praxis Method (Dressing and Eating as Human Ethics)
modes.definition_zh: 穿衣吃饭，即是人伦物理。道不在超越的形上世界，而存在于百姓的日常物质生活之中。将伦理道德从空谈心性拉回到现实生存需求，肯定物质利益是人类行为的基础动力。这是对程朱理学'存天理灭人欲'的直接否定。
modes.definition_en: 'Dressing and eating constitute human ethics and physical principles.' Dao does not exist in a transcendent metaphysical realm but within the daily material life of common people. Bringing ethics from empty contemplation back to practical survival needs, affirming material interests as the fundamental driving force of human behavior—this is a direct negation of Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism's 'preserve heavenly principle, eliminate human desires.'
process: 确认物质生存是人类存在的前提
将伦理讨论从形上拉回现实层面
肯定私欲和物质利益的正当性
在日常实践中体认天道而非空谈玄理

modes.definition_zh: 主动拥抱'异端'标签，以批判者姿态否定传统权威。'咸以孔子之是非为是非，故未尝有是非耳'——不以孔子之是非为是非，而是以独立判断确立自己的是非标准。这是李贽思想最具颠覆性的方法论，将批判精神推向极致。
modes.definition_en: Actively embracing the 'heterodox' label, adopting the critic's stance to negate traditional authority. 'When all take Confucius's judgments as standard, they have never had any judgments of their own'—refusing to take Confucius's correctness as correctness, instead establishing one's own standards through independent judgment. This is Li Zhi's most subversive methodology, pushing critical spirit to its extreme.
process: 质疑既有的权威标准和普遍共识
主动承担'异端'标签以彰显独立立场
以独立判断取代盲从和依附
在批判中确立自己的价值体系

modes.definition_zh: 强调真诚为本，以真情实感作为一切价值和行为的最高标准。猛烈抨击道学家'阳为道学，阴为富贵'的虚伪本质，揭露其'被服儒雅，行若狗彘'的虚伪面目。真情的显现具有真心无伪、直言无忌、天趣无俗、自性无他等特点。
modes.definition_en: Emphasizing authenticity as the foundation, taking genuine emotion and feeling as the highest standard for all values and actions. Vehemently attacking the hypocrisy of Neo-Confucian scholars who 'outwardly dress in Daoist garb but inwardly pursue wealth and status,' exposing their true nature as 'wearing Confucian robes while acting like beasts.' Genuine emotion manifests as absolute sincerity, fearless directness, natural charm uncorrupted by vulgarity, and unmediated self-expression.
process: 审视自身情感的真实性，拒绝自我欺骗
以真情实感作为判断行为价值的标准
揭露并批判一切虚伪矫饰
在真诚表达中实现人格统一

modes.definition_zh: 从儒家教条、礼法束缚中解放思想，主张思想自由和个性表达。认为'天生一人，自有一人之用'，每个人的独特价值不应被统一标准所抹杀。这是晚明思想解放运动的核心方法论，直接启发了公安派的'独抒性灵'主张。
modes.definition_en: Liberating thought from Confucian dogma and ritual constraints, advocating intellectual freedom and individual expression. Holding that 'each person born by Heaven has their own unique utility,' no one's distinct value should be erased by uniform standards. This is the core methodology of the late Ming intellectual liberation movement, directly inspiring the Gong'an School's advocacy of 'expressing one's unique spirit.'

modes.definition_zh: 以现实效用和实践效果检验真理，而非盲从书本教条。'不言理财者决不能平治天下'——任何理论必须能够转化为实际的治理效能。这是对空谈心性的程朱理学的直接反驳，确立了实用主义的认识论标准。
modes.definition_en: Testing truth by practical effectiveness rather than blindly following textual dogma. 'Those who speak not of finance and management certainly cannot bring order to the world'—any theory must be capable of transforming into actual governance effectiveness. This is a direct refutation of Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism's empty contemplation of nature, establishing a pragmatic epistemological standard.
process: 识别理论或主张的实际效用
以实践效果而非经典权威作为检验标准
追求可验证、可操作的真理
在实效中检验和修正认知

modes.definition_zh: 肯定个体独特价值，反对千篇一律的人格塑造。'天生一人，自有一人之用'——每个人都是不可替代的独特存在。李贽本人以特立独行著称，敢于自刎以全其志，是此方法的人格化身。此法强调个性解放是人性完善的必由之路。
modes.definition_en: Affirming individual unique value, opposing standardized personality shaping. 'Each person born by Heaven has their own unique utility'—every individual is an irreplaceable unique existence. Li Zhi himself was renowned for independent and unconventional conduct, daring to commit suicide to preserve his convictions, embodying this method in his very person. This method emphasizes that individual liberation is the necessary path to human perfection.
process: 认识并肯定自身独特性
拒绝被统一标准所同化和抹杀
在个性表达中实现自我价值
以特立独行维护人格尊严

modes.definition_zh: 否定等级尊卑，主张男女平等、士庶无别。赞扬武则天为'圣后'，肯定卓文君善择佳耦，猛烈抨击'男尊女卑'的封建礼教。此法超越了时代的性别局限，是中国古代思想史上最早系统主张男女平等的理论之一。
modes.definition_en: Denying hierarchical distinction, advocating gender equality and sameness of scholars and commoners. Praising Wu Zetian as 'sage queen,' affirming Zhuo Wenjun's wise choice of partner, vehemently attacking the feudal ritual ethic of 'male superiority, female inferiority.' This method transcended the gender limitations of its era, becoming one of the earliest systematic theories advocating gender equality in Chinese intellectual history.
modes.source_chapter: 《焚书·答以女人学道为短见书》
process: 识别并质疑一切等级歧视的合理性
从理论层面否定男尊女卑的合法性
以历史案例证明女性的卓越能力
在实践中推动平等关系建立

modes.definition_zh: 顺应人的自然本性，肯定私欲的正当性。'私者，人之心也，人必有私而后其心乃见'——自私是人心的自然状态，否定私欲等于否定人性本身。此法直接挑战程朱理学'存天理灭人欲'的核心命题，确立了人性论的新范式。
modes.definition_en: Conforming to human nature, affirming the legitimacy of self-interest. 'Self-interest is the mind of humanity; only when humans have self-interest can their mind be seen'—selfishness is the natural state of human heart, and denying desire equals denying humanity itself. This method directly challenges the core proposition of Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism 'preserve heavenly principle, eliminate human desires,' establishing a new paradigm in the philosophy of human nature.
process: 承认私欲是人性的自然组成部分
拒绝将欲望视为道德原罪
在满足合理欲望中实现人生价值
以自然本性为伦理判断的基础

modes.definition_zh: 质疑和颠覆一切既定权威，包括孔孟经典、程朱理学、甚至传统史学的定论。以'与世推移'的历史发展观取代保守主义，认为每个时代都有各自的真理标准。此法是李贽思想体系的战斗武器，也是其最终招致杀身之祸的根本原因。
modes.definition_en: Questioning and subverting all established authority, including Confucian-Mencian classics, Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism, and even traditional historiography's settled conclusions. Replacing conservatism with a progressive historical view that each era has its own standard of truth. This method is the combat weapon of Li Zhi's thought system, and also the fundamental reason he ultimately met his death.
process: 审视一切既定权威的历史条件和时代局限
以'与世推移'的发展观取代保守主义
在新的历史条件下重新评估旧价值
在批判继承中建立新的真理标准

steps_zh: Step 1: 童心溯源——以'绝假纯真'的童心为一切价值判断的起点
Step 2: 物质扎根——将伦理从天上拉回人间，确认'穿衣吃饭即是人伦物理'
Step 3: 异端立场——主动拥抱批判者角色，以'不以孔子之是非为是非'确立独立
Step 4: 真情检验——以真诚为本，揭露一切虚伪矫饰
Step 5: 思想解放——从教条中突围，让每个人都能发挥独特价值
Step 6: 实证验证——以现实效用检验一切理论，拒绝空谈
Step 7: 个性张扬——肯定个体独特性，反对千篇一律
Step 8: 平等普适——打破等级和性别壁垒，建立普遍平等
Step 9: 自然回归——顺应人性本然，肯定私欲的正当
Step 10: 权威颠覆——以历史发展观取代保守主义，不断追问和重建
steps_en: Step 1: Childlike Mind溯源 — Start from 'absolute authenticity' as the origin of all value judgment
Step 2: Material Grounding — Bring ethics from heaven to earth, affirm 'dressing and eating constitute human ethics'
Step 3: Heterodox Positioning — Actively embrace the critic's role, establish independence through 'do not take Confucius's judgments as standard'
Step 4: Genuine Emotion Test — Use authenticity as the standard, expose all hypocrisy
Step 5: Intellectual Liberation — Break through dogma, allow each person to realize unique value
Step 6: Practical Verification — Test all theories by practical effectiveness, reject empty talk
Step 7: Individuality Expression — Affirm individual uniqueness, oppose standardization
Step 8: Universal Equality — Break hierarchical and gender barriers, establish universal equality
Step 9: Natural Return — Conform to human nature, affirm the legitimacy of self-interest
Step 10: Authority Subversion — Replace conservatism with historical progressivism, constantly question and rebuild
expected_zh: 确立'童心说'为中国思想史上的认识论革命，开启晚明思想解放运动
以'穿衣吃饭'颠覆程朱理学的形上本体论，重建伦理的物质基础
以'异端'身份开创中国早期启蒙思想传统，影响黄宗羲、顾炎武等后世思想家
将女性纳入思想史，打破男尊女卑的千年壁垒
以自刎殉道确立思想自由的终极代价，成为后世启蒙者的精神象征
expected_en: Establish 'Childlike Mind Theory' as an epistemological revolution in Chinese intellectual history, launching the late Ming intellectual liberation movement
Subvert Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism's metaphysical ontology through 'dressing and eating,' rebuilding the material foundation of ethics
Pioneer China's early enlightenment tradition as a 'heterodox' thinker, influencing later thinkers such as Huang Zongxi and Gu Yanwu
Bring women into intellectual history, breaking the millennia-old barrier of male superiority
Establish the ultimate cost of intellectual freedom through suicide as martyrdom, becoming the spiritual symbol for later enlightenment thinkers
case_zh: 李贽在麻城芝佛院著述十年，以'异端'自居，写出《焚书》《藏书》，重评历史人物数十位，肯定项羽、刘邦、武则天、卓文君等'非常之人'；他公开赞扬女性智慧，指出'谓见有长短则可，谓男子之见尽长，女子之见尽短，又岂可乎'；他与耿定向等理学名臣展开激烈论战，揭露其'阳为道学，阴为富贵'的虚伪；万历三十年被捕入狱，面对审讯毫不屈服，最终以剃刀自刎，以死殉道。这些事件完整展现了李贽思想从理论建构到实践坚守的完整链条。
case_en: Li Zhi spent ten years writing at Zhifo Monastery in Macheng, identifying as a 'heterodox' thinker, producing Books That Burn and Records to Be Hidden, re-evaluating dozens of historical figures and affirming 'extraordinary persons' such as Xiang Yu, Liu Bang, Wu Zetian, and Zhuo Wenjun. He publicly defended women's intelligence, asserting 'it is acceptable to say some views are short and others long, but to say all men's views are long and all women's views are short—how could that be right?' He engaged in fierce debates with Neo-Confucian scholars such as Geng Dingxiang, exposing their hypocrisy of 'outwardly dressing in Daoist garb but inwardly pursuing wealth and status.' In 1602, arrested and imprisoned, he refused to yield under interrogation, ultimately committing suicide with a razor to preserve his convictions. These events comprehensively demonstrate the complete chain from theoretical construction to practical坚守 of Li Zhi's thought.

meta.source: 基于《焚书》《续焚书》《藏书》《李氏文集》及历代研究
meta.methodology: 文献分析法、概念分析法、比较研究法、思想史分析法
meta.validation: 与王阳明心学、泰州学派、黄宗羲等同时代及后世思想家对比验证
